faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Maharashtra Ex-Servicemen Corporation Limited (MESCO) for filling a specialized advisory role on contract basis in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post under this notification is Administration Consultant, aimed at utilizing the administrative expertise of retired government professionals for organizational efficiency.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Administration Consultant position, making it a highly targeted recruitment drive for qualified retired personnel.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification to apply?
faq.answer: Applicants must have retired from the Government of Maharashtra from the post of Administrative Officer, Section Officer, under Secretary, or an equivalent administrative position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The candidate's age should not be more than 65 years as specified in the recruitment rules and guidelines issued by the organization.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form via email is 30 October 2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission before the deadline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent via Email. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, attach the required documents, and send it to the designated official email address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises the shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview conducted through email, written letter, or telephone.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The appointment will be made on a temporary contract basis for an initial period of 3 months, which can be extended up to a maximum period of 6 months.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I visit for more official details?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official website of the corporation at www.mescoltd.co.in to access all updates, notifications, and application annexures regarding the recruitment.
